translationRepairs: The crown prince said: "Because it is not reached by practice that it can be the root of virtue."
The crown prince said: "It is because it is not reached by practice that it can be the root of virtue."

Chinese 不因積習而至，所以可爲德本 is a causal cleft: it is precisely because filial piety is not attained through accumulated practice that it can be the root of virtue. The original lacks the opening 'It is' and is ungrammatical; the proposed cleft restores that sense without changing meaning.

Because when Emperor Ming of Jin was crown prince had built the Western Pool, he memorialized Shizu citing that precedent and asked to raise a small park on the Eastern Fields; the emperor granted it.

Because when Emperor Ming of Jin was crown prince he had built the Western Pool, he memorialized Shizu citing that precedent and asked to raise a small park on the Eastern Fields; the emperor granted it.

In 以晉明帝爲太子時立西池 the builder of 西池 is Emperor Ming while crown prince; the original subordinate clause drops the finite subject before 'had built' and is ungrammatical. Adding 'he' restores grammar and keeps agent, patient, and the petition to Shizu intact.
